headline: President Obama created a White House council focused on communities and workers affected by problems in the auto industry.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a White House Council on Automotive Communities and Workers. Based on its title, the council's focus is on workers and communities tied to the auto industry. No summary was provided, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: The council was set up with a focus on workers in the auto industry, though the specific actions it would take are not described in the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Communities that depend on auto manufacturing
